newsitem.title: UK: Eskom delays launch of mark Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Eskom delays launch of mark Eurobond.

text.p: South Africa's electricity utility Eskom Ltd has delayed the launch of a 200 million mark five-year Eurobond, an official at lead manager Commerzbank said on Monday.
"Roadshows planned for London, Zurich, Munich and Frankfurt have been delayed due to market conditions," a syndicate manager at Commerzbank in Frankfurt told Reuters.

"They may still take place before the end of the year if the market looks right," he said. However, traders at other banks said investor demand was weak at the moment and was unlikely to pick up until next year.
The Commerzbank official said if investor presentations were held, a bond issue would follow shortly afterwards.
In September South Africa issued a 500 million mark seven-year bond at 140 basis points over Bunds, setting a benchmark for other borrowers from the country.
South Africa's bond was trading around 177 b.p. over at 1200 GMT, traders said.
